snippet.title: Advent NEON - Official Gameplay Trailer | Black Voices in Gaming
snippet.description:
Transform into an engine of destruction in the vaporwave platformer Advent NEON. Shred through enemies at lightspeed – literally – with your ability to freeze time and get the advantage on your foes.

Advent NEON will be released on July 18, 2025. Wishlist it and play the demo on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1528260/Advent_NEON/
